rows.title: Dark-energy wa — DES Y6 + DESI DR2 public; Euclid joint still pending
rows.notes: Sign of wa is negative (evolving DE, same side as FSOT lock). Combined DES+DESI+CMB wa = -0.63^{+0.21}_{-0.18}. Frozen -1.018 is ~1.9σ from that central — not a 3σ exclusion. Euclid DR1 joint posterior still the registered kill surface. Local DESI_wa panel remains green.

rows.title: Muon g-2 — Fermilab final experiment confirmed; lattice SM target moved
rows.kill_if: sign flip vs Fermilab-class excess or theory absorbs full excess without FSOT map

sources.label: Muon g-2 Theory Initiative plenary (2026-08-03 to 08-07)

rows.notes: Experiment did not flip sign: Fermilab final a_mu stays on the 2021 high side (Breakthrough Prize 2026). Versus WP20 R-ratio SM the excess is still ~2.6e-9, matching FSOT 2.49e-9 direction and scale. Versus WP25 lattice SM the recommended theory target moved up and most of the WP20 excess is absorbed. Recorded as partial: experimental lock holds; theory-target rebase is logged, not a retune of the FSOT lock. Next: 2026 Theory Initiative workshop resolution of lattice vs data-driven HVP.
